_comment: Display values from the BBMODEL, except firstperson_lefthand TRANSLATION which is tuned for the game: the bbmodel's [-0.37,3.2,2.63] put the whole rig at screen x=-1.3 (off the left edge). AXIS GUIDE for tuning the worn pose (left hand, so vanilla NEGATES x): more negative x = moves RIGHT toward centre; +y = up; +z = toward the camera / larger. Rotation is untouched. firstperson_righthand is the plain HELD item. A right-handed player's OFFHAND renders in the FIRST_PERSON_LEFT_HAND context, so equipped picks up the worn pose and main-hand the held pose with no branching in code. Third person is NOT driven by thirdperson_* while worn: GauntletArmLayer parents the gauntlet to the arm bone.
